Лаванда.about: One of the few herbal anxiolytics tested in major RCTs (Silexan is a standardized oil). Compare with lorazepam in anxiety studies.
Лаванда.caution: Orally only standardized oil in capsules (Silexan). DO NOT take regular essential oil internally - it is toxic. During pregnancy - avoid. May enhance the effect of sedatives.
Лаванда.food_sources: As a spice in cooking (very little). The main one is essential oil or extract.
Лаванда.guidelines: There is RCT (Silexan vs lorazepam, vs placebo) - one of the few with a decent evidence base. EFSA health claims do not approve.
Лаванда.how_to_choose: Silexan (standardized preparation) or equivalent in capsules. For aromatherapy - 100% essential oil, not aromatic mixtures.
mechs: Linalyl acetate and linalool: modulation of GABA-A and NMDA receptors
Inhibition of calcium channels in neurons
Лаванда.myths: “All essential oils are the same” - no, only the standardized one with linalyl acetate works. “Instantly knocks you out” - a mild effect, not a sleeping pill.
Лаванда.name: Lavender
Лаванда.onset: 30-60 minutes for acute calming effect; 2-6 weeks for sustainable.
Лаванда.title: Lavender
Лаванда.upper_limit: There is no formal UL. Silexan capsules 80-160 mg/day are well tolerated.
Лаванда.who_needs: People with mild to moderate anxiety disorders. Students during stressful periods. As an evening ritual for sleep.
